steps.name: Export the complete Atalaia game for the web
Prepare Similo art for its separate static domain
Check sources and build frontend and native helpers once
Verify contracts and real user journeys
Package and smoke test the actual executable
Accept the real installer on the disposable runner
Prepare the matched frontend and installer download
Save the validated delivery in a private draft release
